raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Draft for early review. No blocking issues. ## Overview With prefix caching and a `--prefix-match-unit` smaller than the Mamba block size, the scheduler stops every prefill at the prompt's last prefix-match-unit boundary so that state gets cached. When the last chunk starts and ends inside one Mamba block, no internal checkpoint can cover that position, so each such prompt pays an extra forward step. This PR adds `--no-mamba-prompt-tail-checkpoint` to skip that stop. The default is unchanged. ## Claims - Off: the prompt's last chunk runs to the end, follow-up prompts resume from the last Mamba block boundary, and no cached state is left inconsistent. - Kimi-K3 agentic disaggregated benchmark on MI355X, flag off on the prefill instance: +0.6% total tok/s/GPU, mean TTFT 3.06 s to 2.82 s, +9% recomputed prefill tokens per request. ## Validation - New tests in `tests/v1/core/test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py`: the opt-out cases fail without the scheduler change and pass with it. - `tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py`, `tests/v1/core/prefix_cache/`, `test_prefix_caching.py`, `test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py`: each file passes on its own. A combined run fails the same 19 `test_scheduler.py` cases on main and on this branch. ruff clean. - End to end: one run per configuration, below.
End-to-end benchmark Kimi-K3, agentic multi-turn trace at concurrency 48, 1 prefill + 1 decode instance on 2 nodes of 8x MI355X, TP8 + DCP8, FP8 KV cache, MoRIIO + `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`. Prefill: `--prefix-match-unit 128`, Mamba block 1536, attention block 12288, 8192 batched tokens. vLLM ROCm nightly `81198e97` with an earlier form of this patch on the prefill instance, which turned off `mamba_partial_cache_hit` in the scheduler. This PR keeps that flag and skips only the tail stop, so this exact diff has not been benchmarked. | | [before](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/actions/runs/39534548941) | [after](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/actions/runs/39592109192) | |---|---|---| | Total tok/s/GPU | 10990 | 11060 (+0.6%) | | p90 interactivity (tok/s/user) | 48.7 | 48.2 | | TTFT mean / p90 | 3.06 s / 6.22 s | 2.82 s / 5.41 s | | Prefill tokens recomputed per request | 5108 | 5580 (+9.2%) | | Prefill prefix-cache hit rate | 93.1% | 93.4% |
## Details `_mamba_block_aligned_split` stops at `get_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_position` only when `mamba_prompt_tail_checkpoint` is set and no internal checkpoint covers the tail. The new scheduler attribute is `mamba_partial_cache_hit and cache_config.mamba_prompt_tail_checkpoint`. The checkpoint granularity still keys on `mamba_partial_cache_hit`, and `MambaManager` and the worker checkpoint logic are untouched, so scheduler, manager and worker stay in lockstep. The test stubs that mirror scheduler attributes gain the new one. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

nodes.body: Opt-out makes sense: the prompt-tail stop only helps when a Mamba-aligned checkpoint can actually be written at that boundary. Default-off is correct. Please undraft when you want CI. Also the e2e numbers come from an earlier patch that also flipped mamba_partial_cache_hit — please remeasure this exact diff before claiming the TTFT delta.

@@ -34,6 +34,8 @@ vllm serve <hybrid-model> \
 
 Choose a value that divides the block size of every prefix-cacheable KV cache group, and that is a multiple of the per-state compression ratio for models that use one, such as sparse MLA. vLLM validates both at startup and names the offending sizes in the error. Read the served block size from the startup log. 64 is a reasonable starting point.
 
+With `--prefix-match-unit` smaller than the Mamba block size, a prefill also stops at the prompt's last prefix-match-unit boundary, so a longer follow-up prompt can resume there. When the backend cannot store that state within the prompt's last chunk, the stop costs one extra forward step per prompt. `--no-mamba-prompt-tail-checkpoint` skips the stop; follow-up prompts then resume from an earlier Mamba state and recompute more tokens.
+
 ## Example workloads
 
 We describe two example workloads, where APC can provide huge performance benefit:

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prompt_tail_checkpoint", [True, False])
+def test_prompt_tail_checkpoint_opt_out_skips_the_tail_stop(
+    prompt_tail_checkpoint: bool,
+) -> None:
+    """A resume one block short of the prompt end runs to the end in one chunk
+    when the prompt-tail stop is disabled."""
+    prompt_len, resume_at = 3602, 2 * MAMBA_BLOCK_SIZE
+    tail_stop = prompt_len // ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE * ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE
+    (request,) = create_requests(1, num_tokens=prompt_len, block_size=ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE)
+    request.num_computed_tokens = resume_at
+    num_new = _split(
+        request,
+        prompt_len - resume_at,
+        use_eagle=False,
+        partial_hit=True,
+        prompt_tail_checkpoint=prompt_tail_checkpoint,
+    )
+    assert resume_at + num_new == (tail_stop if prompt_tail_checkpoint else prompt_len)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prompt_tail_checkpoint", [True, False])
+def test_prompt_tail_checkpoint_opt_out_resumes_from_block_state(
+    prompt_tail_checkpoint: bool,
+) -> None:
+    """Without the tail stop the cached slots stay consistent and a resend
+    resumes from the last Mamba block boundary instead of the prompt tail."""
+    init_none_hash(sha256)
+    prompt_len = 3601
+    manager = _make_hybrid_kv_cache_manager(num_hash_lookahead_tokens=1)
+
+    def make(request_id: str) -> Request:
+        return make_request(
+            request_id,
+            list(range(prompt_len)),
+            ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE,
+            sha256,
+            num_hash_lookahead_tokens=1,
+        )
+
+    producer = make("producer")
+    state_at = _run_chunked_prefill(
+        manager,
+        producer,
+        budgets=[],
+        use_eagle_block_drop=False,
+        partial_hit=True,
+        num_hash_lookahead_tokens=1,
+        prompt_tail_checkpoint=prompt_tail_checkpoint,
+    )
+    assert producer.num_computed_tokens == prompt_len
+    _count_cached_boundary_states(manager, producer, state_at)
+    manager.free(producer)
+    manager.new_step_starts()
+
+    _, num_computed, _ = manager.get_computed_blocks(make("resend"))
+    tail = (prompt_len - 1) // ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE * ATTN_BLOCK_SIZE
+    block = (prompt_len - 1) // MAMBA_BLOCK_SIZE * MAMBA_BLOCK_SIZE
+    assert num_computed == (tail if prompt_tail_checkpoint else block)
